name: PufferGo | 外贸独立站AI建站专家 | AI Website Builder for Export
author: puffergo

sections.description:
PufferGo is an AI website builder crafted by a team of senior engineers from top-tier tech companies. Powered by world-leading large language models, it helps you rapidly generate beautiful websites optimized for Google SEO—empowering export businesses and B2B manufacturers to rapidly build professional brand sites for global markets.
PufferGo 是一款由一线互联网大厂工程师团队打造的 AI 建站工具，专为外贸企业和 B2B 出海商家设计。无需编程基础，输入业务信息即可由 AI 自动分析需求、规划网站结构、生成精美页面，一站式完成外贸独立站搭建。支持中文理解，提供完整的中文支持和微信客服。

Why Choose PufferGo?

  • 🌏 Optimized for Export & B2B – Purpose-built for international trade and B2B business scenarios.
  • 🔍 Google SEO Friendly – Semantic code structure that search engines love.
  • ⚡ Zero Coding Required – No technical background needed. Launch your site in as little as one day.
  • 📱 Fully Responsive – Perfect display on mobile, tablet, and desktop.
  • 🚀 Blazing Fast Performance – Clean, minimal code for instant page loads.
  • 🤖 Top-Tier AI Models – Integrated with world-leading large language models.

Core Features

  • AI Requirements Analysis – Input your business info, and AI organizes your website requirements automatically.
  • Smart Sitemap Generation – Auto-generates site structures following Silo architecture best practices.
  • Intelligent Block Planning – Plans optimal page layouts based on each page’s goals.
  • One-Click Website Generation – AI generates complete pages instantly.
  • Flexible Editing Options – Supports manual editing, AI-assisted editing, or importing HTML from other AI tools.
  • Theme Compatible – Works seamlessly with your WordPress theme styles.

Work With AI Agents (Claude Code, Codex, 豆包, 千问, WorkBuddy)

PufferGo turns your WordPress site into something an AI agent can actually write to. Install a free, open-source
Agent Skill in the AI tool you already use — Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, WorkBuddy, 豆包 (Doubao),
千问 (Qwen), Cursor, or any tool that supports Agent Skills (SKILL.md) — then just talk to it:

  • Bulk product upload – Drop in product photos and specs, and the agent writes the product pages: title,
    specifications, price / MOQ / lead time, gallery and detail sections. One product or a whole catalog.
  • Build and edit pages – Ask for a landing page, a blog post or a case study; the agent writes it as Tailwind
    sections you can still edit in the WordPress editor afterwards. It can also rewrite just one section of a page.
  • SEO silo planning – Turn one line about your business into a keyword map and a pillar / cluster structure,
    then write and push the articles with Rank Math titles, keywords and internal links.

Everything is written as a draft until you say publish, nothing is ever deleted, and your site credentials stay
on your own computer — they never enter the AI conversation. The skills and the CLI are MIT licensed and public:
github.com/puffergo/puffergo-wordpress-ai-agent.

用 AI 工具直接给网站上架产品、写页面

装上一个免费开源的 Agent Skill，就能在你已经在用的 AI 工具里直接对网站干活——Claude Code、Codex、
WorkBuddy、豆包、千问、Cursor，以及任何支持 Agent Skills（SKILL.md）的工具：

  • 批量上架产品 — 把产品照片和资料丢给它，自动整理成产品页：标题、参数、价格/起订量/交期、图库和图文详情。
  • 建页面、写博客、加案例 — 说一句需求就能生成，正文是 Tailwind 区块，之后还能在 WordPress 编辑器里自己改。
  • SEO Silo 规划 — 一句网站定位展开成关键词和支柱/集群结构，成批写文章并带着 Rank Math 的标题、关键词和内链推送。

写到网站上的内容默认都是草稿，你说发布才发布，也没有任何删除操作；网站凭据只保存在你自己的电脑上，绝不进入
AI 对话。技能和命令行工具均为 MIT 开源：
github.com/puffergo/puffergo-wordpress-ai-agent。

Documentation & Support

  • 📖 Documentation: puffergo.com/docs-start
  • 💬 Chinese Support: We provide comprehensive Chinese support to help Chinese businesses go global.
  • 📧 Email / 邮箱: tech@puffergo.com
  • 💬 WeChat / 微信: 联系我们获取微信

External Services

This plugin utilizes PufferGo AI services (api.puffergo.com) to provide artificial intelligence features:

  • Content Generation: Sends prompts to generate text and layouts.
  • Template Sync: Fetches the latest design patterns from our cloud library.

Terms of Service | Privacy Policy

This plugin supports optional third-party analytics services that are disabled by default and require manual activation:

Google Tag Manager

  • Service: Google Tag Manager
  • Status: Disabled by default, requires manual activation in plugin settings
  • Purpose: Used to analyze website traffic and user behavior patterns.
  • Data Transmission: May transmit user IP addresses and browser fingerprint information to Google’s servers.
  • Privacy & Terms: For detailed privacy and security information, please refer to Google Privacy Policy and Google Terms of Service

Baidu Analytics (百度统计)

  • Service: Baidu Analytics (百度统计)
  • Status: Disabled by default, requires manual activation in plugin settings
  • Purpose: Used to analyze website traffic and user behavior patterns for Chinese markets.
  • Data Transmission: May transmit user IP addresses and browser fingerprint information to Baidu’s servers.
  • Privacy & Terms: For detailed privacy and security information, please refer to Baidu Privacy Policy and Baidu Terms of Service
sections.installation:
1. Search for PufferGo in WordPress Admin → Plugins → Add New, or manually upload the plugin to /wp-content/plugins/puffergo.
  2. Activate PufferGo in the Plugins page.
  3. Go to the PufferGo settings page to connect your account and start building.
sections.faq:
Can I use Claude Code, Codex, 豆包 or 千问 to upload products and write pages?

Yes. Install the free, open-source PufferGo Agent Skill in your AI tool, connect it to your site once, and then just
describe what you want: bulk upload products from photos and specs, create and edit pages, blog posts and case
studies, or plan and write a whole SEO silo. Everything is saved as a draft until you publish it, and your site
password never enters the AI conversation. The skills and CLI are MIT licensed:
https://github.com/puffergo/puffergo-wordpress-ai-agent

Is PufferGo free to use?

Yes, we offer a free tier that’s enough to create a complete website. More advanced features are available with paid plans.

Do I need to know how to code?

Not at all. We’ve eliminated all technical barriers, and top-tier AI models from both China and the US are here to assist you. If you run into any issues, feel free to contact us—we’re happy to help. Of course, if you do have technical skills, you’ll find it even smoother to use, but the difference isn’t huge.

How does it help with SEO?

We generate Tailwind HTML code that’s extremely clean and loads incredibly fast. Unlike traditional website builders (like Elementor), there’s no bloated, redundant code.

Where is the data stored?

Only your account-related data is stored on our cloud servers. All other data remains on your own server.
sections.changelog:
0.42.4

  • Leaner Page Output — Pages no longer ship many duplicate copies of the base stylesheet, so the HTML and CSS sent to the browser is noticeably smaller and renders faster.
  • Cleaner Page Source — The component render no longer leaves large blocks of HTML comments in the page source.

0.42.4 (中文版)

  • 页面输出更精简 — 页面不再重复输出多份基础样式，浏览器收到的 HTML 与 CSS 体积明显下降，加载更快。
  • 页面源码更干净 — 组件渲染时不再在页面源码中留下大量 HTML 注释。

0.42.3

  • SVG Compatibility Fix — Components using the <ellipse> SVG tag (two pricing components and one feature-detail component) no longer lose the graphic when page content is saved or published.
  • Documentation Link — The dashboard documentation entry now points to the new docs homepage.

0.42.3 (中文版)

  • SVG 兼容性修复 — 使用 <ellipse> SVG 标签的组件（两款定价组件与一款功能详情组件）在页面保存与发布时不再丢失该图形。
  • 文档链接 — 控制台的文档入口指向新的文档首页。

0.42.2

  • Plugin Version Reported on Component Requests — Component list and component content requests now report the plugin version, consistent with the plugin’s other requests, which makes usage statistics and compatibility work easier.

0.42.2 (中文版)

  • 组件请求上报插件版本 — 组件清单与组件内容的请求现在会携带插件版本号，与插件的其他请求一致，方便统计各版本的使用情况、做好兼容。

0.42.1

  • Structured Data Accuracy — Product, solution, case study and review pages now output structured data consistent with their visible content. Products quoted on request are not given a fabricated price; price ranges, minimum order quantities, lead times, certifications and specifications are taken from the fields actually completed. Company legal name, registration number, country, social profiles and contact details are drawn from the site profile.
  • Page Purpose Declaration — Home, About, Contact, Factory Tour, and the product and case listings now record their page type at generation time instead of inferring it from the URL. Output is the same whether or not an SEO plugin is active.
  • Site Profile Fields — Optional legal name, registration number and country/region fields added. Existing sites are unaffected when they are left blank.
  • Component Library Expansion — The library now offers 203 components. Preview images were completed for 16 previously affected components, and creation and update timestamps are derived from revision history rather than from build time.
  • Component Library Browsing — Components can be sorted by newest, oldest or recently modified, and opened directly in the block editor for verification.
  • Price Unit Parsing — Currency is retained for price formats such as “USD/m” and “USD per piece”.
  • Design Scheme Validation — A scheme with an unbalanced comment is rejected when saved, instead of storing rules that browsers will discard.
  • AI Site Builder Completion Checks — Placeholder blocks no longer count as generated content. All pages must be fully generated before publishing is allowed, and any remaining pages are named. The generation screen advises keeping the page open, and pages containing only placeholders can be regenerated.

0.42.1 (中文版)

  • 结构化数据准确性 — 产品、方案、案例与评价页面输出的结构化数据与页面可见内容保持一致。面议产品不编造价格；区间价、起订量、交期、认证与规格取自实际填写的字段。公司法定名称、注册号、国别、社媒与联系方式由站点资料生成。
  • 页面用途标注 — 首页、关于我们、联系我们、工厂参观，以及产品与案例列表，在生成时记录页面类型，不再依据网址推断。输出不受是否启用 SEO 插件影响。
  • 站点资料字段 — 新增法定名称、注册号、国家/地区三项可选字段，留空不影响现有站点。
  • 组件库扩充 — 组件库扩充至 203 款，补齐 16 款组件的预览图；组件创建与更新时间改为取自版本记录，不再随构建时间变化。
  • 组件库浏览 — 支持按最新添加、最早添加、最近修改排序，并可直接在块编辑器中打开组件进行验证。
  • 价格单位解析 — 「USD/m」「USD per piece」等写法不再丢失币种。
  • 设计方案校验 — 注释未闭合的设计方案在保存时即被拒绝，避免存入会被浏览器忽略的样式规则。
  • AI 建站完成度校验 — 占位区块不再计为已生成内容。进入发布前要求全部页面生成完成，并列出缺失的页面；生成期间提示保持页面打开；仅含占位内容的页面可重新生成。

0.41.0

  • Some Components Now Belong to a Paid Plan — A small set of the most advanced components is reserved for paying customers. Free sites still see them in the library, with a VIP badge on the preview and a “VIP only” button, so you always know what you are missing. Clicking it tells you what it costs to unlock — nothing is silently hidden.
  • Your Plan, Clearly Shown — The component library now shows which plan your site is on (Free, VIP, or SVIP) right at the top, with a direct link to upgrade. No more guessing which features you have.
  • One Upgrade Link, Everywhere — The upgrade prompt on a locked component, the “out of credits” notice, and the plan page now all lead to the same billing page. One click, no dead ends.
  • VIP and SVIP Kept Separate — Paid components can be marked for VIP or SVIP independently. Right now both plans unlock the same set, but the two tiers are separate from day one, so SVIP-only designs can be added later without another plugin update.
  • Page Templates Can Be Reserved Too — Advanced page, header and footer templates can now carry the same plan requirement. Locked templates are marked in the picker and cannot be selected until the plan allows them.
  • Unlocking Takes Effect on Its Own — After an upgrade, pinned components unlock by themselves within the hour; you do not need to reinstall the plugin or reconnect your site.
  • AI Site Builder Stops Offering Templates You Cannot Use — The template picker used to list components that are not included in your plan, and the build failed at the very end. It now only offers what your plan can actually insert, so a template you can pick is a template that works.

0.41.0 (中文版)

  • 部分组件现在属于付费套餐 — 一小批进阶组件保留给付费客户。免费站点在组件库里照样能看到它们，预览图上带 VIP 角标、按钮显示「VIP 专享」，缺什么一眼就知道。点下去会直接告诉你升级后就能用——不会悄悄藏起来让你找不到。
  • 当前套餐一眼可见 — 组件库顶部现在直接显示站点属于哪个套餐（免费版 / VIP / SVIP），旁边就是升级入口，不用再猜自己有哪些权益。
  • 升级入口只有一个 — 组件锁的提示、积分不足的提示、套餐页，现在都指向同一个账单页。点一次就到，不会走进死胡同。
  • VIP 与 SVIP 分开管理 — 付费组件可以分别标记给 VIP 或 SVIP。目前两个套餐可用范围完全一致，但两档从一开始就是独立的，以后加入 SVIP 专属设计不需要再改代码。
  • 页面模板也能设专属档位 — 进阶页面模板、页头与页脚现在同样可以设套餐要求。未解锁的模板会在列表里标注且不可选，升级后自动可用。
  • 升级后自动解锁 — 升级完成，被锁的组件会在一小时内自己解开，不需要重装插件，也不需要重新连接站点。
  • AI 建站不再列出用不了的模板 — 以前模板选择器会列出套餐里没有的组件，等建到最后一刻才失败。现在只给当前套餐真能插进去的模板，选得到就等于用得了。

0.39.1

  • Long-Running Jobs Stop Reporting a Timeout That Never Happened — Planning the blocks of a page on a large site can take seven or eight minutes. The progress bar gave up at six, showed “Job timed out”, and threw away the answer the server was about to hand back. It now keeps waiting quietly in the background — checking every twenty seconds, for up to twice the original limit — and the window before it gives up is twelve minutes instead of six. The job itself is never cancelled; you simply stop being told it failed while it is still running.
  • Clearer Wording When the Wait Really Is Too Long — If a job still has not come back after that, the message now says how many seconds it has been waiting rather than naming a limit you never set. Nothing is lost by closing the panel: the job keeps running on the server, and reopening the step picks it up again.

0.39.1 (中文版)

  • 长任务不再报一个根本没发生的超时 — 大站的区块规划要跑七八分钟，而进度条六分钟就放弃，弹出「Job timed out」，把服务端马上要交回来的结果丢掉了。现在到点不再判失败，而是安静地在后台接着等——每 20 秒问一次，最多等到原来的两倍时长——同时等待窗口从 6 分钟放宽到 12 分钟。任务本身从来不会被取消，你只是不再被提前告知它失败了。
  • 真的等太久时，文案说人话 — 如果过了这个时间还没回来，提示会直接讲已经等待了多少秒，而不是抛一个你从没设过的上限。这时候关掉面板也不丢东西：任务还在服务端跑，重新打开这一步就能接上。

0.39.0

  • Your Site Goes Live When You Say So — The homepage used to be switched the moment the pages were created, so while you were still reviewing them, anyone visiting your site saw an empty front page. The switch now happens on the same click that publishes: “Publish All” puts the pages live, sets the new homepage, and opens it in a new tab, so what you see is exactly what visitors see. Until then, nothing on the site changes.
  • An Existing Homepage Is Replaced, and Named Before You Click — When your site already had a static front page, PufferGo used to leave it untouched and tell you to go set the new one yourself under Settings → Reading. Publishing now sets the new homepage outright, with the old one named in the dialog first. The old page is kept — switch back under Settings → Reading any time.
  • A Warning Before Rebuilding a Site That Already Has One — If the site already carries pages PufferGo built, choosing Custom or Fast now asks once before starting and spells out what happens: same addresses, content replaced, nothing deleted, nothing public yet. Choose “Not Now” and you stay on step one — the site profile can still be edited and saved.
  • Failed Pages Are Named, and Retried Without Regenerating — If a page does not go live, the dialog stays open, names the page and the reason, and the main button turns into “Retry Publishing”, which sends only the pages that failed. The homepage is set as soon as that page itself is live, so one stubborn subpage no longer holds your front page hostage.
  • Bug Fix: Backing Out No Longer Takes Your Live Pages Down — Rebuilding a site reuses the pages already on it. They used to be reset to draft the moment they were regenerated, so even if you then chose not to publish, those live pages had already disappeared for visitors. They now keep whatever status they had.
  • Bug Fix: The Build Wizard’s Default Model — The default AI model for the build wizard pointed at a channel that had been retired, so the very first generation failed with an error. It now opens on a model that works.

0.39.0 (中文版)

  • 你说发布，网站才上线 — 以前页面一建好，首页就跟着换过去了：你还在核对内容，访客打开的已经是一个空白首页。现在换首页和发布是同一次点击——点「Publish All」才发布页面、设新首页，并自动开一个新标签，让你看到访客看到的那个样子。在那之前，站上什么都没变。
  • 已有的首页会被替换，点之前先告诉你换成谁 — 站点原来有静态首页时，以前 PufferGo 不碰它，让你自己去「设置 → 阅读」手动设。现在点发布就直接设为新首页，弹窗里先写清原首页是哪一页。旧页面不会被删，随时可以在「设置 → 阅读」换回去。
  • 重建已有的站，先问一次 — 站上已经有 PufferGo 建过的页面时，点 Custom 或 Fast 会先确认一次，并讲明后果：地址不变、内容被替换、什么都不删、什么都还没对外。点「Not Now」就停在第 1 步，站点画像照样能改、能存。
  • 失败的页面会被点名，重试不用重新生成 — 有页面没发出去时，弹窗不关，列出是哪一页、什么原因，主按钮变成「重新发布」，只补发没成功的那几页。首页自己一发布成功就设上去，不再被某个次要页拖住。
  • 修复：点「暂不发布」不再让线上页面下线 — 重建站点会复用站上已有的页面。以前这些页一重新生成就被退成草稿，所以你就算最后选择不发布，线上那几个页面对访客已经消失了。现在它们保持原来的发布状态。
  • 修复：建站向导的默认模型 — 向导默认用的 AI 模型指向一条已经下架的通道，第一次生成就报错。现在默认用可用的那个，打开就能跑。

0.38.0

  • Your AI Tool Now Knows What Your Site Is For — The site profile (brand, audience, trust data, tone, keywords) lives in one place, and your AI tool can finally read it before writing. Every page, article and product it writes then speaks with one voice and uses your real numbers. Updating follows the same safe pattern as category trees: export to a file, check the dry-run, write it back — with an automatic backup of the previous version.
  • Header and Footer Menus, Edited by Conversation — “Add CNC Milling under Products”, “rename Blog to Insights”, “open this link in a new tab” — your AI tool exports the menu as a tree file, edits fields, nests children and reorders items in the file, dry-runs the diff for you to approve, then writes it on. Items you leave out are kept untouched and listed, and nothing is ever deleted from the conversation; deleting stays a human click in wp-admin. On multilingual sites the response says exactly which translations need a rerun in the Translation Center.

0.38.0 (中文版)

  • AI 工具现在知道你网站是干什么的 — 站点画像（品牌、目标客户、信任数据、语气、关键词）只存一份，AI 写内容之前先读它：写出来的每个页面、每篇文章、每个产品都跟你的站一个口径、用你的真实数字。更新走和分类树一样的安全流程：导出成文件、干跑核对、再写入——改之前自动存一份改前的备份。
  • 页头页脚菜单，对话里改 — 「Products 下面加个 CNC Milling」「把 Blog 改成 Insights」「这个链接开新窗口」——AI 把菜单导成一份树文件，在文件里改字段、挂子项、调顺序，先干跑把差异给你过目，确认后写入。文件里没出现的项原样保留并逐一列出来；从对话里永远删不掉东西，删除是后台里的人工一次点击。多语言站上，返回里会明确说哪些语言的翻译要去翻译中心重跑一次。

0.37.0

  • AI Body Text Reads Well Everywhere — Body text written by the PufferGo AI skill used to look polished only inside the standard article layout. Once it left that container — in the AI preview, in theme-styled blog posts, or as AI-written body text placed on pages, products or solutions — it fell back to bare, unstyled paragraphs. PufferGo now ships its own AI-ready body typography: comfortable paragraph spacing, readable sizes, and styled headings, lists and quotes. Where your theme already styles the text, the theme still wins, so existing sites look exactly as they did.
  • Bug Fix: AI Content Styles No Longer Leak Into Layout Blocks — On article pages where the PufferGo AI skill writes body text between design blocks, the body container’s typography used to bleed into those blocks: white text inside a dark call-to-action band got overridden into dark-on-dark, unreadable — and only on the live page, where the AI editor preview looked fine. Body styling now targets AI-written body content alone; every layout block keeps its own colors and spacing.

0.37.0 (中文版)

  • AI 写的正文到哪里都有排版了 — 以前用 PufferGo AI 技能写的正文只有在标准文章版式里才好看；一旦离开那个容器——AI 预览、主题样式的文章页面、或者放到产品/解决方案/普通页面上的 AI 内容——就变成没样式的裸段落。现在 PufferGo 自带一套为 AI 内容准备的正文排版：段距舒适、字号易读，标题、列表、引用都有样式。如果你自己的主题本来就有排版，仍以主题优先，现有站点观感不变。
  • 修复：AI 内容的排版不再渗进版式块 — 在 PufferGo AI 技能把正文写进版式块之间的文章页里，正文容器的排版会渗到这些版式块上：深色 CTA 带里的白字被覆盖成深底深字，根本读不出来，而且只有前台会坏，AI 编辑器预览看不出问题。现在正文样式只作用于 AI 写入的正文本身，每个版式块保持自己的颜色和间距。

0.36.0

  • Body Text Travels Both Ways — Your AI tool no longer has to rebuild a page from its HTML to change one paragraph.   • 版块该长什么样就长什么样 — 带背景图的版块不再被压成一块灰片，改用深色遮罩配白字，照片看得见、文字也读得清。五个首页版块存在肉眼可见的排版硬伤，现已修复；还有一个版块的图片会溢出到下一个区块里。我们也收紧了组件库的上线前体检，面板上能看到的设置，点下去就是真的有用。

0.29.0

  • Every Image Slot Now Tells You What Size to Upload — You no longer have to guess how big a photo should be. Select any image in a section and the panel tells you the exact size, aspect ratio and format to prepare — and a “Crop it” link takes you straight to our cropping tool with those numbers already filled in, so you never have to copy them by hand. The sizes are not estimates: we render every component in a real browser and measure each slot, so what you see is what that position actually needs.
  • The Advice Fits the Slot, Not a One-Size-Fits-All Rule — A full-screen banner, a product card and a customer logo need completely different things, so they get completely different advice. Banners get a width range and a note to keep your subject centred, because their height changes with each visitor’s screen. Logos and certificates are told to keep any shape they like on a transparent background — asking you to squeeze a square logo into a wide strip would be nonsense. Only slots with a genuinely fixed shape get an exact size and ratio.
  • Recommended Sizes Are Tuned to Keep Your Pages Fast — Bigger is not better. Image file size grows with the square of its width, and a photo that is twice as wide can be four times heavier, which your visitors pay for on every page load — especially on phones. The suggested sizes are capped so your pages stay sharp without becoming slow, and WebP is recommended throughout for smaller files at the same quality.
  • Phones Now Download Small Images, Not Full-Size Ones — Until now every visitor downloaded the same full-size photo, whether they were on a 27-inch monitor or a phone on mobile data. WordPress has quietly been saving smaller copies of every image you upload since day one — we simply were not using them. Now each image offers the browser the full set of sizes and lets it pick the right one, which measured out at roughly a third less image data on a phone with no visible difference on desktop. You do not prepare anything extra and you do not change how you work: upload one photo exactly as before. This also clears Google’s “Properly size images” warning, which counts towards your Core Web Vitals score. It applies to blog posts, case studies, solutions and product pages as well as sections.
  • Blog and Case Study Header Images Are No Longer Stretched — Featured images at the top of an article were being served at 1024 pixels wide and then stretched to fill a screen half again as wide, which looked soft on every display regardless of device. They now use the full-resolution photo, and the thumbnails in “related articles” lists were similarly undersized and have been corrected.
  • Round Portraits No Longer Squash Faces — Team photos, author avatars and testimonial portraits used to stretch sideways if the photo you uploaded was not perfectly square — faces came out visibly widened. They now crop to the centre instead, …

short_description: AI website builder for B2B export sites: bulk upload products, create and edit pages, write SEO articles — with Claude Code, Codex, 豆包 or 千问.
description:
PufferGo is an AI website builder crafted by a team of senior engineers from top-tier tech companies. Powered by world-leading large language models, it helps you rapidly generate beautiful websites optimized for Google SEO—empowering export businesses and B2B manufacturers to rapidly build professional brand sites for global markets.
PufferGo 是一款由一线互联网大厂工程师团队打造的 AI 建站工具，专为外贸企业和 B2B 出海商家设计。无需编程基础，输入业务信息即可由 AI 自动分析需求、规划网站结构、生成精美页面，一站式完成外贸独立站搭建。支持中文理解，提供完整的中文支持和微信客服。

Why Choose PufferGo?

  • 🌏 Optimized for Export & B2B – Purpose-built for international trade and B2B business scenarios.
  • 🔍 Google SEO Friendly – Semantic code structure that search engines love.
  • ⚡ Zero Coding Required – No technical background needed. Launch your site in as little as one day.
  • 📱 Fully Responsive – Perfect display on mobile, tablet, and desktop.
  • 🚀 Blazing Fast Performance – Clean, minimal code for instant page loads.
  • 🤖 Top-Tier AI Models – Integrated with world-leading large language models.

Core Features

  • AI Requirements Analysis – Input your business info, and AI organizes your website requirements automatically.
  • Smart Sitemap Generation – Auto-generates site structures following Silo architecture best practices.
  • Intelligent Block Planning – Plans optimal page layouts based on each page’s goals.
  • One-Click Website Generation – AI generates complete pages instantly.
  • Flexible Editing Options – Supports manual editing, AI-assisted editing, or importing HTML from other AI tools.
  • Theme Compatible – Works seamlessly with your WordPress theme styles.

Work With AI Agents (Claude Code, Codex, 豆包, 千问, WorkBuddy)

PufferGo turns your WordPress site into something an AI agent can actually write to. Install a free, open-source
Agent Skill in the AI tool you already use — Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, WorkBuddy, 豆包 (Doubao),
千问 (Qwen), Cursor, or any tool that supports Agent Skills (SKILL.md) — then just talk to it:

  • Bulk product upload – Drop in product photos and specs, and the agent writes the product pages: title,
    specifications, price / MOQ / lead time, gallery and detail sections. One product or a whole catalog.
  • Build and edit pages – Ask for a landing page, a blog post or a case study; the agent writes it as Tailwind
    sections you can still edit in the WordPress editor afterwards. It can also rewrite just one section of a page.
  • SEO silo planning – Turn one line about your business into a keyword map and a pillar / cluster structure,
    then write and push the articles with Rank Math titles, keywords and internal links.

Everything is written as a draft until you say publish, nothing is ever deleted, and your site credentials stay
on your own computer — they never enter the AI conversation. The skills and the CLI are MIT licensed and public:
github.com/puffergo/puffergo-wordpress-ai-agent.

用 AI 工具直接给网站上架产品、写页面

装上一个免费开源的 Agent Skill，就能在你已经在用的 AI 工具里直接对网站干活——Claude Code、Codex、
WorkBuddy、豆包、千问、Cursor，以及任何支持 Agent Skills（SKILL.md）的工具：

  • 批量上架产品 — 把产品照片和资料丢给它，自动整理成产品页：标题、参数、价格/起订量/交期、图库和图文详情。
  • 建页面、写博客、加案例 — 说一句需求就能生成，正文是 Tailwind 区块，之后还能在 WordPress 编辑器里自己改。
  • SEO Silo 规划 — 一句网站定位展开成关键词和支柱/集群结构，成批写文章并带着 Rank Math 的标题、关键词和内链推送。

写到网站上的内容默认都是草稿，你说发布才发布，也没有任何删除操作；网站凭据只保存在你自己的电脑上，绝不进入
AI 对话。技能和命令行工具均为 MIT 开源：
github.com/puffergo/puffergo-wordpress-ai-agent。

Documentation & Support

  • 📖 Documentation: puffergo.com/docs-start
  • 💬 Chinese Support: We provide comprehensive Chinese support to help Chinese businesses go global.
  • 📧 Email / 邮箱: tech@puffergo.com
  • 💬 WeChat / 微信: 联系我们获取微信

External Services

This plugin utilizes PufferGo AI services (api.puffergo.com) to provide artificial intelligence features:

  • Content Generation: Sends prompts to generate text and layouts.
  • Template Sync: Fetches the latest design patterns from our cloud library.

Terms of Service | Privacy Policy

This plugin supports optional third-party analytics services that are disabled by default and require manual activation:

Google Tag Manager

  • Service: Google Tag Manager
  • Status: Disabled by default, requires manual activation in plugin settings
  • Purpose: Used to analyze website traffic and user behavior patterns.
  • Data Transmission: May transmit user IP addresses and browser fingerprint information to Google’s servers.
  • Privacy & Terms: For detailed privacy and security information, please refer to Google Privacy Policy and Google Terms of Service

Baidu Analytics (百度统计)

  • Service: Baidu Analytics (百度统计)
  • Status: Disabled by default, requires manual activation in plugin settings
  • Purpose: Used to analyze website traffic and user behavior patterns for Chinese markets.
  • Data Transmission: May transmit user IP addresses and browser fingerprint information to Baidu’s servers.
  • Privacy & Terms: For detailed privacy and security information, please refer to Baidu Privacy Policy and Baidu Terms of Service
